title: 游戏计划书｜现实时间人生模拟
description: 3D browser life simulation with a clock following actual local time, street exploration, apartment, convenience-store work, money, purchases and saves.

contract.qaTelemetry: When ?qa=1, expose read-only window.__LIFESIM_QA__.getState(); do not enable money or time cheats in public runtime.
contract.time: World wall clock follows device local time on load, focus, and resume; a short game task may be compressed, but never fake the wall clock.
contract.money: Each completed job payout is idempotent; purchases never result in negative balances; local save is versioned and reloadable.
contract.save: Persistence survives reload; corrupted saves fall back safely and signal the user rather than erase all game data silently.
contract.standalone: The first playable prototype must run in a local browser without fetching a remote 3D engine at startup.
